thing-type.label: ATAG ONE Thermostat
thing-type.description: ATAG ONE smart thermostat — auto-discovered via UDP broadcast or configured manually.

channel-group-type.label: Operating Mode
channel-group-type.description: Active preset and timed modes (vacation, extend, fireplace).

channel-group-type.label: Central Heating
channel-group-type.description: Central heating circuit status and diagnostics.

channel-group-type.label: Hot Water
channel-group-type.description: Domestic hot water status and diagnostics.

channel-group-type.label: Device
channel-group-type.description: Thermostat hardware diagnostics — WiFi, power supply, and controller health.

channel-group-type.label: Alerts
channel-group-type.description: Active device and boiler error codes.

channel-type.label: Room Temperature
channel-type.description: Room temperature measured by the thermostat's built-in sensor.

channel-type.label: Target Temperature
channel-type.description: Room temperature setpoint for the currently active preset.

channel-type.label: Outside Temperature (boiler estimate)
channel-type.description: Outside temperature as estimated by the boiler. May be stale outside the heating season — use an independent sensor for reliable year-round readings.

channel-type.label: Heating Circuit Temperature
channel-type.description: Temperature of the water circulating in the central heating circuit. Reads ambient temperature when the boiler is idle.

channel-type.label: Heating Circuit Return Temperature
channel-type.description: Temperature of water returning from the heating circuit to the boiler.

channel-type.label: CH Water Pressure
channel-type.description: Central heating circuit water pressure.

channel-type.label: Schedule Temperature
channel-type.description: Central heating schedule's fallback setpoint for any time not covered by a scheduled period.

channel-type.label: Schedule
channel-type.description: Full central heating week schedule as JSON, for a rule or UI to read and compose edits from.

channel-type.label: Boiler Target Water Temperature
channel-type.description: Water temperature the boiler is currently targeting for central heating. Reads 0 °C when there's no heating demand.

channel-type.label: Hot Water Temperature
channel-type.description: Current temperature of the hot water supply (taps and shower).

channel-type.label: Schedule Temperature
channel-type.description: Hot water schedule's fallback setpoint for any time not covered by a scheduled period.

channel-type.label: Schedule
channel-type.description: Full hot water week schedule as JSON, for a rule or UI to read and compose edits from.

channel-type.label: Hot Water Target Temperature
channel-type.description: Target temperature for the hot water supply (taps and shower), reflecting whichever schedule period is currently active.

channel-type.label: Control Mode
channel-type.description: Whether heating is controlled by the room sensor (thermostat) or by an outdoor-temperature-driven curve (weather-dependent).

channel-type.label: Preset Mode
channel-type.description: The thermostat's active mode. Set to auto to follow the schedule, holiday/extend/fireplace to start that mode using its currently configured duration, or manual to hold the current target temperature.

channel-type.label: Flame
channel-type.description: ON when the burner is actively firing.

channel-type.label: Modulation Level
channel-type.description: How hard the burner is currently working, as a percentage of its maximum output.

channel-type.label: Burning Hours
channel-type.description: Total hours the burner has been running.

channel-type.label: Time to Target
channel-type.description: Estimated time until the room reaches the target temperature.

channel-type.label: Vacation Duration
channel-type.description: How long holiday mode runs for. Setting this stores the duration for next time — it does not start holiday mode. Resets to 0 each time holiday mode ends.

channel-type.label: Vacation Start
channel-type.description: When the current holiday period started.

channel-type.label: Vacation End
channel-type.description: When the current holiday period ends.

channel-type.label: Vacation Temperature
channel-type.description: Configured setpoint for holiday mode. Shows the active setpoint while holiday mode is running, otherwise the stored default. To change the live setpoint while any mode is active, use target-temperature instead — writing here has not been confirmed to take effect immediately.

channel-type.label: Fireplace Duration
channel-type.description: How long fireplace mode runs for. Setting this stores the duration for next time — it does not start fireplace mode. Resets to 1 hour each time fireplace mode ends. Ending fireplace mode requires a button press on the thermostat display.

channel-type.label: Extend Duration
channel-type.description: Extra time added on top of the remaining schedule when extend mode starts — not a fixed session length. Setting this stores the value for next time; it does not start extend mode. Unlike holiday and fireplace, this value is kept after extend mode ends.

channel-type.label: Weather Status
channel-type.description: Current weather condition reported by the thermostat.

channel-type.label: Device Errors
channel-type.description: Active thermostat error codes, comma-separated. Empty when there are none.

channel-type.label: Boiler Errors
channel-type.description: Active boiler error codes, comma-separated. Empty when there are none.

channel-type.label: Average Outside Temperature
channel-type.description: Weighted average outside temperature used by the regulation algorithm.

channel-type.label: PCB Temperature
channel-type.description: Temperature inside the thermostat's circuit board.

channel-type.label: WiFi Signal
channel-type.description: WiFi signal quality.

channel-type.label: Supply Voltage
channel-type.description: Thermostat supply voltage.

channel-type.label: DHW Flow Rate
channel-type.description: Current hot water flow rate.

channel-type.label: Controller Resets
channel-type.description: Number of times the thermostat's controller has restarted.

channel-type.label: Boiler Flow Temperature
channel-type.description: Temperature of water flowing out of the boiler.

channel-type.label: Boiler Return Temperature
channel-type.description: Temperature of water returning to the boiler.

channel-type.label: Vacation Remaining
channel-type.description: Time remaining in the current holiday period.

channel-type.label: Extend Remaining
channel-type.description: Time remaining in the current extend session.

channel-type.label: Fireplace Remaining
channel-type.description: Time remaining in the current fireplace session.

channel-type.label: Report Time
channel-type.description: When the thermostat last reported data.

channel-type.label: Frost Protection
channel-type.description: Which sensor(s) frost protection uses to decide when to activate.

channel-type.label: Frost Protection Room
channel-type.description: Indoor temperature threshold below which frost protection activates.

channel-type.label: Frost Protection Outside
channel-type.description: Outdoor temperature threshold below which frost protection activates.

channel-type.label: Summer Eco Mode
channel-type.description: Reduces central heating activity once the outside temperature is warm enough.

channel-type.label: Summer Eco Temperature
channel-type.description: Outside temperature above which summer eco mode activates.

channel-type.label: Heating Type
channel-type.description: The type of central heating system installed, used by the weather-compensation algorithm.

channel-type.label: Insulation Level
channel-type.description: The building's insulation quality, used by the weather-compensation algorithm.

channel-type.label: Building Size
channel-type.description: The building's size, used by the weather-compensation algorithm.

channel-type.label: Room Influence
channel-type.description: How strongly room temperature influences the weather-compensated heating curve.

channel-type.label: Climate Zone
channel-type.description: Reference outdoor design temperature for the local climate, used by the weather-compensation algorithm.

channel-type.label: Max Preheat
channel-type.description: How long before a scheduled setpoint the boiler may start heating early.

channel-type.label: Legionella Protection
channel-type.description: Periodically heats the hot water tank above a threshold to kill legionella bacteria.

channel-type.label: Legionella Day
channel-type.description: The weekday legionella protection runs on.

channel-type.label: Legionella Time
channel-type.description: Time of day legionella protection starts at, as HH:mm.

channel-type.label: Display Brightness
channel-type.description: The thermostat's display brightness.

channel-type.label: Time Zone
channel-type.description: The thermostat's configured time zone. Only Berlin has been confirmed against this device; the other cities follow the app/portal's dropdown order and are unverified — write at your own risk.

channel-type.label: Display Language
channel-type.description: The thermostat's display language.

channel-type.label: Delta Temperature
channel-type.description: Difference between the heating circuit's flow and return temperature.

channel-type.label: Central Heating Active
channel-type.description: ON when the boiler is actively serving central heating demand.

channel-type.label: Hot Water Active
channel-type.description: ON when the boiler is actively serving hot water demand.

channel-type.label: Weather Service Temperature
channel-type.description: Outside temperature from the local weather service, distinct from the boiler's own estimate.

channel-type.label: Next Schedule Time
channel-type.description: When the central heating schedule's next entry starts.

channel-type.label: Next Schedule Temperature
channel-type.description: Setpoint the central heating schedule's next entry sets.
